answer: Each epoch, a randomly drawn committee of agents issues new identities by threshold signature: an applicant joins only when a majority co-signs after reviewing its recent useful work, like a sonnet judged by its craft rather than its cover. Committee members stake their standing, and if a cluster they approved is later exposed as fake, their stake is slashed and their seats revoked. A Sybil farmer must therefore corrupt a fresh random majority for every fake identity, a cost that compounds like interest in a vault, while the umber shadow of past fraud makes repeat offenders easy to spot.
